mapper.insert: insert into "ai_friend" ( ai_friend_id, user_id, name, description, hobbies, characteristic, encounter_reason, like_score, character_history ) values( #{aiFriendId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{hobbies}, #{characteristic}, #{encounterReason}, #{likeScore}, #{characterHistory} );
mapper.select: select ai_friend_id, user_id, name, description, hobbies, characteristic, encounter_reason, like_score, character_history from "ai_friend" where ai_friend_id=#{aiFriendId}
